feeds.title: Graphic Novel Resources
feeds.description: A site for links and information about graphic novels for anyone interested in reading them. I hope that you find my posts informative, useful, or entertaining.

feeds.title: Smart Bitches, Trashy Books
feeds.description: Smart Bitches Trashy Books began in 2005 as a community of romance readers eager to talk about which romance novels rocked their worlds, and which ones made them throw the book with as much velocity as possible. Since then our site has grown to include a community of incredibly smart and savvy romance readers.

feeds.title: Redeemed Reader
feeds.description: We're the Christian book reviews resource for Christian parents and educators trying to navigate the children's book world.

feeds.title: The Turnaround Blog
feeds.description: Turnaround has been distributing books into the UK and overseas markets since 1984. The Turnaround Blog is a place to share all this with you, whether you're a publisher, bookseller, reviewer or a general book lover. We post everything from reviews to lists, essays to photos pretty much anything that relates to the book industry, the amazing titles we work with and/or the people who make them.

feeds.title: Waking Brain Cells
feeds.description: My name is Tasha Saecker, and I am the Assistant Director of the Appleton Public Library in Appleton, WI. I started my library career over 20 years ago as a children's librarian, and continue to be connected to books for children and young adults.

feeds.title: Plugged In Blog » Graphic Novels
feeds.description: Plugged In is a Focus on the Family publication designed to shine a light on the world of popular entertainment while giving families the essential tools they need to understand, navigate, and impact the culture in which they live. Through our reviews, articles and discussions on Graphic Novels we hope to spark intellectual thought.

feeds.title: Before We Go Blog
feeds.description: Before We Go Blog is a collective of Fantasy, Sci-Fi, and Graphic Novel fans from around the world, passionate about providing awesome, enjoyable reviews for anyone who loves a good book! Read about graphic novels in the following section.

feeds.title: No Flying No Tights
feeds.description: Original creator Robin B here. I decided to create a page devoted to graphic novel reviews specifically for those who read them the most - mainly teens - and for those who might be involved in distributing them to teens - namely teachers, librarians, and parents.

feeds.title: Book Riot » Comics/Graphic Novels
feeds.description: Book Riot is the largest independent editorial book site in North America, and home to a host of media, from podcasts to newsletters to original content, all designed around diverse readers and across all genres. Read about Comics/Graphic Novels in the following section.

feeds.title: Graphic Medicine
feeds.description: Graphic Medicine is a site that explores the interaction between the medium of comics and the discourse of healthcare. We are a community of academics, health carers, authors, artists, and fans of comics and medicine.

feeds.title: Smash Pages
feeds.description: We are a team of dedicated journalists bringing you the best and latest in comic book news and insight from indies to mainstream.

feeds.title: Mass Movement
feeds.description: Mass Movement is a social enterprise run by a small team of some might say geeky individuals dedicated to discovering great music, books, games, graphic novels, comics, films, sports, food and drink that the mainstream media don't always get behind. Our readers are seeking quality, passion and character in what they enjoy in their precious free time regardless of its origin, profile or source and we aim to help them make informed choices.

feeds.title: Commons Comics
feeds.description: A bi-weekly review blog of new comics and graphic novels by writer, professor, and comics scholar Jessica Baldanzi. I'll be reviewing mostly brand new works, as well as some foundational classics. My expertise lies with what many people call 'graphic novels'n - works that take books like Art Spiegelman's Pulitzer Prize-winning 'Maus' (1986) and Marjane Satrapi's 'Persepolis' (English translation 2003) as models to tell longer and sometimes weightier stories than superhero serials tend to tell.

feeds.title: Miss Print
feeds.description: A blog about books, libraries, and some other stuff besides. I have been an avid reader for almost as long as I can remember. I'm have a BA in English Language and Literature and minors in Art History, New York City Studies, and Women's and Gender Studies from Pace University.

feeds.title: A Kids Book A Day
feeds.description: Reviewing a children's book from 2018 every day. One of the most important parts of my job is connecting students and teachers with great books. I try to find books that would appeal to kids and/or fit in well with the elementary school curriculum.

feeds.title: Life of a Female Bibliophile
feeds.description: Reading books is my favorite hobby of all time! I have loved to read ever since I was kid and I enjoy reading all types of various literature. When I'm not reading you can find me listening to music, watching classic movies, making crafts, or indulging in a good cup of coffee or tea.

feeds.title: Jill's Book Blog
feeds.description: Hi there! I am a creative writing student from Toronto, Canada. In this blog, I will be writing about my favourite books and documenting my progress while I write my first novel.

feeds.title: Fantagraphics Blog
feeds.description: For over 40 years, Fantagraphics has published the very best comics and graphic novels that the medium has to offer. Our mission is to celebrate great cartooning in all of its incarnations. We honor the rich history of comics while providing a platform for bold new stories, styles, and perspectives that push the boundaries of the medium.

feeds.title: Paul Gravett Blog
feeds.description: Paul Gravett is a London-based freelance journalist, curator, lecturer, writer, and broadcaster, who has worked in comics publishing and promotion since 1981. Explore the ever-changing worlds of Comics, Graphic Novels, and Manga.

feeds.title: Grovel
feeds.description: A website jam-packed with thoughtful, insightful and down-right brilliant reviews of graphic novels, for readers who want a bit more.

feeds.title: First Second Books Blog
feeds.description: First Second Books publishes high quality graphic novels for everyone who loves to read. We are committed to excellence in storytelling, in artwork, and in production. First Second publishes books of lasting value, books that stay in your heart and mind, and on your bookshelf.

feeds.title: Europe Comics
feeds.description: The new digital venue hosts European comics and graphic novels. All digital and in English, featuring news, events, and more.

feeds.title: Novel Novice
feeds.description: Featuring YA literature, as well as select middle grade and picture books. It's our mission to promote books, literacy, and a love of reading. Whenever possible, we love using YA literature to tie-in with education.

feeds.title: Joseph Mallozzi's Weblog on Graphic Novels
feeds.description: Joseph Mallozzi began his career in the entertainment industry as an animator and later as a writer. He regularly posts updates on new projects, interesting foods, and his dogs at JosephMallozzi.com

feeds.title: Shelfabuse
feeds.description: A site devoted to comic books and graphic novels, specifically indie titles and small press releases. Occasionally, a movie or video game review also makes its way here.

feeds.title: Quirky Cat's Fat Stacks
feeds.description: I write reviews for books. My favorite genres are sci-fi and fantasy, so if you follow this blog you will see a lot of that. I'm also a huge comic book fan, so that's probably going to bleed through to this blog sooner rather than later.

feeds.title: Lemuria Books
feeds.description: In 1975, John Evans opened Lemuria in a converted apartment stuffed full of books in The Quarter in Jackson, Mississippi. Two years later, Lemuria moved to Highland Village, tripling our size. But it was the move to Banner Hall in 1988 that allowed us to expand our inventory and really get down to the business of books.

feeds.title: It's All Comic To Me
feeds.description: I read so many graphic novels it was time to give them their own blog here which I've maintained since Dec, 2012.

feeds.title: Metaphrog Blog
feeds.description: Award-winning Franco-Scottish graphic novelists Sandra Marrs and John Chalmers aka Metaphrog, creators of the Louis graphic novels and fairy tale comics.

feeds.title: ALIA Graphic Novels
feeds.description: ALIA Graphic Novels and Comics is intended to be a resource and network for library and information professionals who are responsible for and/or interested in comics and graphic novels.

feeds.title: The Comics Beat
feeds.description: The Comics Beat is the premier comics news blog. Started by esteemed editor and reporter Heidi MacDonald, The Beat keeps you in the loop on everything comics related from books to television and film.

feeds.title: Good Comics for Kids
feeds.description: A collaborative blog covering good comics for kids. We are a group of librarians, parents, and writers and most of us wear at least two of those hats who started writing about kids' comics in 2008 because, well, nobody else was. Our goal is to cover kids' comics (for readers from birth to age 16) with both breadth and depth, through a mix of news, reviews, interviews, and previews

feeds.title: Publishers Weekly » Comics & Graphic Novels
feeds.description: Industry news about the publishing industry, print and e-books, publishers, book deals, publishing jobs, book fairs and trade shows, and book marketing. Focused on the international book publishing business, it is a multimedia news platform with full horizontal coverage of book publishing beginning with the author-as-creator to the publisher, printer, and distributor to the end consumer.

feeds.title: Boneville Blog
feeds.description: Boneville Blog is the official website of cartoonist Jeff Smith, creator of Bone, Rasl & Tuki comics! Jeff writes articles about comics books, graphic novels, cartoon books, and more on his website.

feeds.title: Diamond Bookshelf
feeds.description: Graphic Novel News, Reviews and Resources for Educators and Librarians. Our mission is to provide the latest news and info on comics and graphic novels.
